blocks.text: X-axis Cartesian coordinate system (do lakeeron wala graph) ya kisi data figure, jaise graph, chart ya plot, ki ufqi (horizontal) lakeer hai. Is par aam taur par independent variable (jo hum khud badalte hain) dikhaya jata hai. X-axis woh bunyadi lakeer (baseline) hai jis ke muqable mein doosre variables (aam taur par y-axis par) naape jate hain. Yeh hamesha baayen se daayen ufqi banti hai, aksar origin (0, 0) se shuru ho kar musbat (positive) taraf jati hai, lekin zaroorat ho to manfi (negative) qeematein bhi rakh sakti hai. Biology mein x-axis par aksar waqt ke waqfe, mukhtalif species ya experiment ke halaat dikhaye jate hain. Yeh muqable ki bunyad deti hai aur variables ke darmiyan rujhan (trend) ya taalluq dikhati hai.
